name: kiro-remote-bridge
description: Bridges your kiro-remote-relay to this Kiro IDE window, so you can reply to IDE chat sessions from your phone.

kiroRemoteBridge.enabled.description: Poll the relay and deliver remote replies into this window's Kiro chat sessions.

kiroRemoteBridge.relayUrl.description: Base URL of your deployed kiro-remote-relay, e.g. https://kiro-remote-relay.vercel.app

kiroRemoteBridge.agentSecret.description: Must match AGENT_SHARED_SECRET on the relay. Stored in your local settings — keep this machine trusted.

kiroRemoteBridge.pollIntervalMs.description: How often (ms) to poll the relay for new remote messages. Every poll spends Redis commands on the relay (Upstash free tier caps at 500K/month), and this runs per open IDE window, so keep this in step with kiro-remote-agent's POLL_INTERVAL_MS rather than lowering it alone.
